# Code of conduct

This project is small and friendly, and we would like it to stay that way.

- Be kind. Assume the other person is trying to help, and that they were not born knowing what you know.
- Disagree with ideas, not with people. Say what you think is wrong and why; do not say who is wrong.
- No harassment, insults, or discrimination of any kind. Not in issues, pull requests, discussions or anywhere the project
  is discussed.
- Keep it useful: a clear report with the details asked for gets a faster answer than a frustrated one, and a patient
  answer gets a better report next time.

Maintainers may edit, hide or remove comments and contributions that break these rules, and may ask a person to stop or
leave the project's spaces when the behavior does not stop.

To report a problem, contact a maintainer privately — through GitHub's *Report content* on the comment, or by opening a
[private security advisory](https://github.com/kyzmapiratov/Menagerie/security/advisories/new) if it cannot be said in
public. Reports are treated in confidence.

This text is inspired by the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/), which is worth reading in full
if you want more.
